note: Caribou-Targhee NF campground beside WY-22 at the foot of Teton Pass, about 7 mi SE of Victor, ID, run by a concessionaire. Sites in a meadow edged with fir, spruce and aspen; the highway is visible and audible from most sites. Gravel spurs suited to smaller RVs. --Claude
summary: FS (found at /trail-creek) and rec.gov current. 9 public sites + host (6 reservable, 3 first-come), $17, extra vehicle $8, 2027 May 21 - Sep 5, weekend 2-night minimum. Creekside stands (sites 007 and 010 at the creek). Closed for the rest of 2026 for WY-22 construction. Booking (manual) not overwritten. Phone empty -> (541) 351-1182; add the FS page.
flags: WATERFRONT (checked hard): 'creekside' stands. At 100 m scale Trail Creek (~3-6 m wide) shows through the trees along the SW edge of the east loop: site 007 (43.53890,-111.03721, reservable, nightly) ~10 m from the channel; site 010 (43.53862,-111.03648, reservable, nightly) ~20 m across grass with a couple of conifers; 009 ~25 m behind conifers. FS: 'Trail Creek flowing alongside many of the campsites'; rec.gov: 'many of which back onto the creek'. The west-loop sites (001-005) are 60 m+ from the creek through forest.

STATUS: FS 'Closed for the rest of the season due to highway construction' (WY-22, 2026). A 2026 seasonal closure that the season end already covers; no status written. Reviewer may want to check the 2027 opening if the construction continues.

BOOKING (provenance manual, not overwritten): the catalog agrees with the stored reservable / recreation.gov / some_sites (6 reservable, 3 first-come).
